title: Firewall global-options batch validation hardening
acceptance_criteria: Global-options batch endpoint rejects missing values for set-operations with explicit 400 errors.
Global-options batch endpoint rejects values for no-arg delete/toggle operations with explicit 400 errors.
Global-options batch endpoint validates enum values for enable/disable, source-validation, state-policy action, and state-policy log-level operations.
Global-options batch endpoint validates timeout batch values as integers within allowed bounds and rejects invalid values with 400 errors.
Global-options batch endpoint normalizes accepted enum values to canonical lowercase before builder invocation.
Regression tests cover invalid and valid batch value flows.
assumptions: Batch clients may still send mixed-case enum values, so canonical lowercase normalization preserves compatibility while improving consistency.
Timeout values in batch payloads are expected as numeric strings from frontend callers and are normalized to integers before builder invocation.
Browser e2e smoke remains out-of-gate on this host until Playwright shared libraries are installed.

tasks.notes: Added strict batch-operation value validation, timeout range checks, arity enforcement, and canonical lowercase normalization for enum operations.
Added regression tests for missing/set/delete value errors, enum/timeout validation, and successful normalized batch execution.
